## Declarations and implementations

```plato
//==
// # Random
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Random numbers and probability distributions
//  - Continuous distributions
//  - Gamma and beta family distributions
//  - Discrete distributions
//  - Multivariate distributions

//==
// # Random numbers and probability distributions
//
// A deterministic random-number generator state and a vocabulary of parametric
// probability distributions (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Random_number_generation;
// https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Probability_distribution). Distributions are
// pure parameter records; drawing samples pairs a distribution with a
// RandomState in a later pass. The distribution interface lives in
// `random.concepts.plato`, the distributions themselves in the sections below,
// and every body in `random.library.plato`.

// The state of a PCG-style pseudo-random generator
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Permuted_congruential_generator). State
// advances by a fixed linear-congruential step on every draw; Stream selects
// one of many independent sequences. The same (State, Stream) pair always
// yields the same next value, so generation is pure: each draw returns a new
// RandomState.
type RandomState
    implements IValue, IHashable
{
    State: Integer;
    Stream: Integer;
}

//==
// # Continuous distributions
//
// The elementary continuous families and the heavy-tailed, lifetime, and
// shaped laws built beside them: the uniform and normal forms, the
// waiting-time and power-law distributions, and the circular von Mises
// distribution. Each type is a pure parameter record; its Mean/Variance/Pdf/
// Cdf bodies live in `random.library.plato`, which also states the
// parameterization and the preconditions of each family. The gamma and beta
// families follow in the next section.

// Uniform density on [Min, Max].
type UniformDistribution
    implements IProbabilityDistribution
{
    Min: Number;
    Max: Number;
}

// The Gaussian distribution with the given mean and standard deviation.
type NormalDistribution
    implements IProbabilityDistribution
{
    Mean: Number;
    StandardDeviation: Number;
}

// A positive variable whose logarithm is normally distributed; LogMean and
// LogStandardDeviation parameterize that underlying normal.
type LogNormalDistribution
    implements IProbabilityDistribution
{
    LogMean: Number;
    LogStandardDeviation: Number;
}

// Waiting time between Poisson events. Rate is per unit; the mean is 1 / Rate.
type ExponentialDistribution
    implements IProbabilityDistribution
{
    Rate: Number;
}

// A heavy-tailed distribution with undefined moments: Mean and Variance
// conventionally report Location and positive infinity.
type CauchyDistribution
    implements IProbabilityDistribution
{
    Location: Number;
    Scale: Number;
}

// A double-sided exponential peaked at Location with diversity Scale.
type LaplaceDistribution
    implements IProbabilityDistribution
{
    Location: Number;
    Scale: Number;
}

// A lifetime distribution: Shape below 1 models infant mortality, 1 is
// exponential, above 1 models wear-out failures.
type WeibullDistribution
    implements IProbabilityDistribution
{
    Shape: Number;
    Scale: Number;
}

// A power-law tail on values at or above MinimumValue, decaying with the
// given Shape exponent.
type ParetoDistribution
    implements IProbabilityDistribution
{
    MinimumValue: Number;
    Shape: Number;
}

// A triangular density rising from Min to a peak at Mode and falling to Max.
type TriangularDistribution
    implements IProbabilityDistribution
{
    Min: Number;
    Mode: Number;
    Max: Number;
}

// A circular distribution of angles concentrated around MeanDirection; the
// circular analog of the normal distribution. Concentration 0 is uniform on
// the circle. Pdf and Cdf take the angle in radians, and Mean reports the
// mean direction in radians.
type VonMisesDistribution
    implements IProbabilityDistribution
{
    MeanDirection: Angle;
    Concentration: Number;
}

//==
// # Gamma and beta family distributions
//
// The continuous families whose densities are expressed with the gamma or
// beta function: the gamma distribution itself, the beta distribution on
// [0, 1], and the chi-squared and Student's t sampling distributions derived
// from the normal. Each type is a pure parameter record; its
// Mean/Variance/Pdf/Cdf bodies live in `random.library.plato`,
// which also states the parameterization and the preconditions of each family.

// The gamma distribution in shape/scale form; its mean is Shape * Scale.
type GammaDistribution
    implements IProbabilityDistribution
{
    Shape: Number;
    Scale: Number;
}

// A distribution on [0, 1] with shape parameters Alpha and Beta; the conjugate
// prior of a Bernoulli success probability.
type BetaDistribution
    implements IProbabilityDistribution
{
    Alpha: Number;
    Beta: Number;
}
```
